name: University of Bradford

facts.text: The University of Bradford was established in 1966 as the UK's fortieth university, and its campus is at Richmond Road, Bradford, West Yorkshire, BD7 1DP.
In 2024/25 Bradford had 10,887 students, of whom 2,908 were international students from the EU and overseas.
Bradford created the first Peace Studies department at a British university in 1973 and became the first British 'University of Sanctuary' in 2018.
Bradford is ranked 2nd in the UK for Optometry, 3rd for Paramedic Science and 5th for Chemical Engineering, and 1st in England for social mobility (2021-2024).
The university's partners include Bradford 2025 (UK City of Culture), Bradford City AFC, the Bradford Literature Festival and the National Science and Media Museum.

sources.notes: University conducts 'mandatory pre-CAS applicant support interviews' (separate from any UKVI credibility interview). Quote: 'This interview will be conducted via Teams or Google Meet and will last for approximately 1 hour.' Conducted in English; English ability is checked. Quote: 'If the interview suggests that you are not a genuine student or your risk of visa refusal is high, we do reserve the right to refuse your CAS.' No mention of CAS Shield or Enroly on the page.

sources.notes: Probed 8 September 2026: the subdomain answers HTTP 200 with the Enroly CAS Shield sign-in page (random subdomains answer nothing), so the university runs its CAS process through Enroly. CAS Shield interviews follow the themes in Brunel's published policy; whether this university switches the interview on for every Nepali applicant is not stated here.
